description: This file defines the CurrencyDataLoader class and related enums, constants, and data structures for loading and managing currency exchange rate data within the CalculatorApp project. It includes interface implementations for data loading and currency conversion, as well as network handling and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: CurrencyDataLoader
classes.description: A class responsible for loading, caching, and providing currency exchange rate data, implementing interfaces for data loading and currency conversion, with network and cache management.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the data loader, optionally with a language override.

methods.name: ~CurrencyDataLoader
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Checks if the data loading process has finished.

methods.name: LoadedFromCache
methods.description: Indicates if data was loaded from cache.

methods.name: LoadedFromWeb
methods.description: Indicates if data was loaded from the web.

methods.name: LoadData
methods.description: Initiates the data loading process.

methods.name: GetOrderedCategories
methods.description: Returns categories of currency data in a specific order.

methods.name: GetOrderedUnits
methods.description: Returns units within a category in a specific order.

methods.name: LoadOrderedRatios
methods.description: Loads conversion ratios for a given unit.

methods.name: SupportsCategory
methods.description: Checks if a category is supported.

methods.name: SetViewModelCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for view model updates.

methods.name: GetCurrencySymbols
methods.description: Retrieves symbols for two currency units.

methods.name: GetCurrencyRatioEquality
methods.description: Gets the ratio equality between two currency units.

methods.name: GetCurrencyTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the currency data.

methods.name: RoundCurrencyRatio
methods.description: Rounds a currency ratio to a specific precision.

methods.name: TryLoadDataFromCacheAsync
methods.description: Attempts to load data from cache asynchronously.

methods.name: TryLoadDataFromWebAsync
methods.description: Attempts to load data from the web asynchronously.

methods.name: TryLoadDataFromWebOverrideAsync
methods.description: Attempts to load data from the web with override options asynchronously.

methods.name: OnNetworkBehaviorChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in network behavior.

methods.name: ResetLoadStatus
methods.description: Resets the load status state.

methods.name: NotifyDataLoadFinished
methods.description: Notifies that data load has finished, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: TryFinishLoadFromCacheAsync
methods.description: Completes cache loading process asynchronously.

methods.name: TryParseWebResponses
methods.description: Parses web responses into internal data structures.

methods.name: TryParseStaticData
methods.description: Parses static currency data JSON.

methods.name: TryParseAllRatiosData
methods.description: Parses all ratios data JSON.

methods.name: FinalizeUnits
methods.description: Finalizes unit setup after data parsing.

methods.name: GuaranteeSelectedUnits
methods.description: Ensures selected units are valid and set.

methods.name: SaveLangCodeAndTimestamp
methods.description: Saves language code and timestamp info.

methods.name: UpdateDisplayedTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp display.

methods.name: RegisterForNetworkBehaviorChanges
methods.description: Registers for network behavior change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterForNetworkBehaviorChanges
methods.description: Unregisters from network behavior change notifications.

methods.name: GetDefaultFromToCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves default 'from' and 'to' currency units asynchronously.

methods.name: TryGetLastUsedCurrenciesFromLocalSettings
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve last used currencies from local settings.

methods.name: SaveSelectedUnitsToLocalSettings
methods.description: Saves selected currency units to local settings.
